summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by GSK plc, a UK-based foreign private issuer, reporting routine share acquisitions by PDMRs through dividend reinvestment. The transactions occurred on July 9, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange, with prices and volumes listed for each executive, including CEO Luke Miels. There are no special-situation elements such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or strategic review. The filing serves as a standard periodic report of insider transactions, not a corporate event, and thus does not qualify under any special-situations category. No deal terms or advisory details are present.
